mapper.select:
SELECT d.draft_id AS draftId, d.title, LEFT(d.content, 20) AS preview, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attachments a WHERE a.draft_id = d.draft_id AND a.attachment_type = 'file') AS attachCnt, d.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM drafts d WHERE d.user_id = #{userId} AND d.board_id = #{boardId} ORDER BY d.updated_at DESC, d.slot_no ASC
LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT attachment_id AS attachmentId, file_name AS originName, file_size AS fileSize, file_url AS fileUrl FROM attachments WHERE draft_id = #{draftId} AND attachment_type = 'file' ORDER BY attachment_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO drafts (user_id, board_id, slot_no, category_id, title, content, is_anonymous, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{boardId}, #{slotNo}, #{request.categoryId}, #{request.title}, #{request.content}, #{request.isAnonymous}, NOW(), NOW())

INSERT INTO attachments (post_id, draft_id, file_name, file_url, file_size, file_type, attachment_type, uploaded_by, created_at) VALUES (NULL, NULL, #{originName}, #{fileUrl}, #{fileSize}, #{fileType}, #{attachmentType}, #{uploadedBy}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT file_url FROM attachments WHERE post_id IS NULL AND draft_id IS NULL AND created_at < (NOW() - INTERVAL #{cutoffHours} HOUR)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM attachments WHERE post_id IS NULL AND draft_id IS NULL AND created_at < (NOW() - INTERVAL #{cutoffHours} HOUR)
